name: John S. Seaton
bio: John S. ("Uncle John") Seaton was an old Medora hand who in March 1885 sent the paper, from Yonkers, New York, an account of the adventures of the Jones & Pennell outfit. He returned from the Black Hills in March 1886 to keep books for Bob Roberts, and in June 1886 the paper ran a comic account of a vagrancy trial in "Judge Seaton's court."

moments.label: Returned from the Black Hills to stay the summer
Named as judge in a comic account of a vagrancy trial

mentions: The following is an account of the adventures of Jones & Pennell's outfit, written by Uncle John Seaton, whom all will remember as the one who always put up the jobs on the boys for which Bob and Joe always had to stand the blame:   Sec. 8, Croton Aqueduct, Yonkers N. Y.…
Uncle John Seaton is expected here soon. He will keep books for Bob Roberts in his work on the Ft. Fetterman branch of the Northwestern this summer.
Uncle John Seaton came in from the Black Hills, Monday morning. He is as full of life as in the old days and expects to stay all summer.
In Judge Seaton's court last Saturday, Mr. A. 1. Stiff was brought up under the vagrant act. A jury of our most reputable citizens was impanelled after considerable difficulty, juror Ga…
